subject: 英语
description: 初中七年级下册英语中考考点笔记总结

units.unit_name: 描述当下与正在发生：现在进行时

cards.title: 现在进行时：正在进行的动作
cards.definition: 现在进行时表示说话时正在发生或现阶段正在进行的动作，强调动作的持续性。
core_points: 构成: 主语 + be动词(am/is/are) + 动词现在分词(-ing)。 (Structure: Subject + be verb (am/is/are) + present participle (-ing).)
否定: 在be动词后加not。 (Negative: Add not after the be verb.)
疑问: 将be动词提前到主语前。 (Interrogative: Move the be verb before the subject.)
主要用法: 表示说话时正在发生的事，常与now, look, listen等词连用。 (Main usage: Actions happening at the moment of speaking, often with now, look, listen.)
次要用法: 表示现阶段正在持续的动作，不一定在说话时发生。 (Secondary usage: Actions ongoing in the current period, not necessarily at the moment of speaking.)

example.question: Look! The children ______ (play) football in the park now.
steps: 1. 识别提示词「Look!」和时间状语「now」，表明动作正在进行。
2. 确定主语「The children」是复数。
3. 根据现在进行时构成：主语 + be + 动词-ing。

mistakes.correct: He is going to school. (忘记ing形式)
They are playing outside. (忘记be动词)

cards.memory_tip: 「be动ing，正在行！」（Be动词加动词ing，表示动作正在进行）

related.next: 一般现在时与现在进行时的对比

exam_focus.scoring_key: 「时态一致看时间状语，主谓一致看be动词，动词变化需规范」
exam_focus.common_trap: 「忽略be动词或动词ing形式变化，如run→running，swim→swimming，live→living」

real_exam_example.question: —What are you doing, Amy? —I ______ (listen) to music.
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 「考查现在进行时的构成，根据问句时态和主语I判断be动词形式。」

cards.title: 现在进行时：动词-ing变化规则与特殊用法
cards.definition: 掌握动词变-ing形式的规则，以及现在进行时在特定情境下的引申用法。
core_points: 一般情况: 动词词尾直接加-ing。 (General case: Add -ing directly to the verb.)
以不发音e结尾: 去e加-ing。 (Ending in silent e: Drop e, add -ing.)
重读闭音节单音节词: 双写末尾辅音字母再加-ing。 (Single-syllable word with stressed short vowel: Double the final consonant, then add -ing.)
以-ie结尾: 变ie为y再加-ing。 (Ending in -ie: Change ie to y, then add -ing.)
特殊用法: 表示按计划即将发生的动作（常用于位移动词）。 (Special usage: Actions happening in the near future according to a plan (often with verbs of movement).)

example.question: My aunt ______ (come) to visit us next week.
steps: 1. 识别时间状语「next week」和动词「come」，且是位移动词。
2. 现在进行时可表示按计划即将发生的动作。
3. 根据主语「My aunt」是单数，动词「come」去e加-ing。

mistakes.correct: running (双写n)
making (去e)

related.prerequisite: 动词原形，元音辅音概念

exam_focus.scoring_key: 「熟记-ing形式变化规则，特殊用法判断语境」
exam_focus.common_trap: 「不规则变化动词的误用，如die→dying，lie→lying；忽略位移动词表示将来时」

real_exam_example.question: The train ______ (leave) at 8 o'clock tomorrow morning.
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 「考查现在进行时表示将来计划的用法，注意与一般将来时的区别。」

units.unit_name: 描述过去事件：一般过去时

cards.title: 一般过去时：规则动词的过去式
cards.definition: 一般过去时表示在过去某个特定时间发生、完成的动作或存在的状态。
core_points: 构成: 主语 + 动词过去式。 (Structure: Subject + past tense verb.)
规则动词变过去式: 一般在词尾加-ed。 (Regular verbs form past tense by adding -ed.)
以不发音e结尾: 直接加-d。 (Ending in silent e: Add -d directly.)
以辅音字母+y结尾: 变y为i再加-ed。 (Ending in consonant + y: Change y to i, then add -ed.)
重读闭音节单音节词: 双写末尾辅音字母再加-ed。 (Single-syllable word with stressed short vowel: Double the final consonant, then add -ed.)

example.question: My father ______ (watch) a football match last night.
steps: 1. 识别时间状语「last night」，表明动作发生在过去。
2. 动词「watch」是规则动词。
3. 根据规则动词变过去式的方法，直接加-ed。

mistakes.correct: studied (变y为i再加-ed)
stopped (双写p再加-ed)

cards.memory_tip: 「过去式，ed记牢，yesterday，last time，过去信号早知道！」

related.next: 一般过去时否定疑问句，不规则动词

exam_focus.scoring_key: 「识别过去时间状语，熟练掌握规则动词-ed变化」
exam_focus.common_trap: 「不规则动词误用规则变化，或规则变化时拼写错误」

real_exam_example.question: They ______ (live) in Beijing for five years before they moved to Shanghai.
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 「句中「before they moved to Shanghai」提示过去动作，动词live是规则动词。」

cards.title: 一般过去时：不规则动词的过去式
cards.definition: 不规则动词的过去式没有统一规则，需要逐一记忆，是中考常考点。
core_points: 构成: 主语 + 不规则动词的过去式。 (Structure: Subject + irregular past tense verb.)
核心: 重点记忆常见的几十个不规则动词的过去式。 (Core: Memorize dozens of common irregular past tense verbs.)

常见类型: 原形与过去式完全不同（如go-went），元音变化（如sing-sang），词尾变化（如make-made），不变式（如put-put）。 (Common types: Completely different (e.g., go-went), vowel change (e.g., sing-sang), ending change (e.g., make-made), unchanged (e.g., put-put).)
否定句: 主语 + did not + 动词原形。 (Negative: Subject + did not + verb base form.)
疑问句: Did + 主语 + 动词原形？ (Interrogative: Did + Subject + verb base form?)

example.question: My sister ______ (go) to the library yesterday afternoon.
steps: 1. 识别时间状语「yesterday afternoon」，表明动作发生在过去。
2. 动词「go」是不规则动词。
3. 记忆go的过去式是went。

mistakes.correct: I didn't go to school. (did后动词用原形)
Did he come? (did后动词用原形)

cards.memory_tip: 「不规则，背背背！Did一出，原形归位！」

related.prerequisite: 规则动词过去式，动词原形

exam_focus.scoring_key: 「熟记不规则动词过去式，否定疑问句中动词还原为原形」
exam_focus.common_trap: 「不规则动词未记忆导致拼写错误或误用规则变化，did后动词仍用过去式」

real_exam_example.question: Last Sunday, Tom ______ (buy) a new book from the bookstore.
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 「根据时间状语「Last Sunday」判断为一般过去时，动词buy为不规则动词，过去式为bought。」

cards.title: 一般过去时：be动词的过去式
cards.definition: be动词在一般过去时中有两种形式：was (用于单数主语) 和 were (用于复数主语)。
core_points: 单数主语: I, he, she, it 或单数名词/不可数名词，用was。 (Singular subjects: I, he, she, it, or singular/uncountable nouns, use was.)
复数主语: you, we, they 或复数名词，用were。 (Plural subjects: you, we, they, or plural nouns, use were.)
否定句: 在was/were后加not。 (Negative: Add not after was/were.)
疑问句: 将was/were提前到主语前。 (Interrogative: Move was/were before the subject.)
用法: 表示过去某一时间的状态、存在或特征。 (Usage: Describe states, existence, or characteristics at a past time.)

example.question: My parents ______ (be) very busy last weekend.
steps: 1. 识别时间状语「last weekend」，表明动作发生在过去。
2. 动词是「be」，主语「My parents」是复数。
3. 根据主谓一致原则，复数主语过去时用were。

mistakes.correct: He was happy yesterday. (He是单数)
They weren't at home. (They是复数)

cards.memory_tip: 「I he she it，was跟着跑；you we they，were来报道！」

related.prerequisite: be动词现在时用法，主谓一致
related.next: 一般过去时与现在完成时的对比

exam_focus.scoring_key: 「识别过去时间状语，判断主语单复数，正确选择was/were」

real_exam_example.question: There ______ (be) a lot of people at the party last night.
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 「根据「last night」判断为一般过去时，There be句型中be动词形式由后接名词「a lot of people」(复数)决定。」

units.unit_name: 表达能力、请求与必要性：情态动词can/must

cards.title: 情态动词can：能力、请求与可能性
cards.definition: 情态动词can表示能力、请求、允许或可能性。
core_points: 表示能力: 「能，会」做某事。 (Ability: 'can' do something.)
表示请求: 「可以」做某事（口语中常用）。 (Request: 'Can I...?' (common in spoken English).)
表示允许: 「可以」做某事。 (Permission: 'You can...'.)
表示可能性: 「可能」会发生某事（常用于否定句或疑问句）。 (Possibility: 'Can' happen (often in negatives or questions).)
否定形式: cannot / can't。 (Negative form: cannot / can't.)
疑问形式: Can + 主语 + 动词原形？ (Interrogative form: Can + Subject + verb base form?)

example.question: My little brother ______ (can run) very fast now.
steps: 1. 动词「can run」表示能力。
2. 情态动词后直接跟动词原形。
3. 主语是「My little brother」，与can无关，直接使用can run。

mistakes.correct: He can speak English. (情态动词后动词用原形)
Can you help me? (情态动词后不带to)

cards.memory_tip: 「Can助动，原形跟，能力请求样样行！」

related.next: 情态动词must，情态动词的辨析

exam_focus.scoring_key: 「情态动词后加动词原形，理解can的不同语义」
exam_focus.common_trap: 「情态动词后动词加s或ing，或加to；不能与be able to混淆使用」

real_exam_example.question: —______ I use your pen? —Sure, here you are.
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 「考查情态动词表示请求的用法。」

cards.title: 情态动词must：义务、必要与推测
cards.definition: 情态动词must表示义务、必要性、命令或非常肯定的推测。
core_points: 表示义务/必要性: 「必须」做某事。 (Obligation/Necessity: 'Must' do something.)
表示命令: 「必须」做某事（语气强硬）。 (Command: 'Must' do something (strong tone).)
表示肯定的推测: 「一定，肯定」是/有。 (Strong inference: 'Must be/have'.)
否定形式: must not / mustn't（表示「禁止」）。 (Negative form: must not / mustn't (meaning 'forbidden').)
疑问形式: Must + 主语 + 动词原形？ (Interrogative form: Must + Subject + verb base form?)

example.question: You ______ (must finish) your homework before going out.
steps: 1. 句子表示「出去前必须完成作业」，是义务或必要性。
2. 情态动词must后直接跟动词原形。
3. 主语是「You」，与must无关，直接使用must finish。

mistakes.correct: He must go now. (情态动词后动词用原形，不带to)
You mustn't smoke here. (mustn't表示禁止，后跟原形)

cards.memory_tip: 「Must必须，禁令强，原形跟着莫彷徨！」

exam_focus.scoring_key: 「情态动词后加动词原形，区分must的否定形式mustn't（禁止）与don't have to（不必）的含义」
exam_focus.common_trap: 「mustn't与don't have to的混淆；情态动词后动词形式错误」

real_exam_example.question: It's late. You ______ (must go) to bed now.
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 「考查情态动词must表示必要性的用法，后接动词原形。」

units.unit_name: 地点与存在表达：方位介词与There be句型

cards.title: 方位介词：描述位置与方向
cards.definition: 方位介词用于表示物体或人物所处的位置、方向或空间关系。
core_points: 表示在...里/上/旁: in (在...里面), on (在...上面), at (在...处)。 (In/on/at: in (inside), on (on the surface), at (at a specific point).)
表示在...附近/之间: near (在...附近), next to (在...旁边), between (在...之间)。 (Near/between: near (close to), next to (adjacent to), between (in the middle of two).)
表示在...前/后/对面: in front of (在...前面), behind (在...后面), opposite (在...对面)。 (Front/back/opposite: in front of, behind, opposite.)
表示在...上/下/上方: above (在...上方，不接触), below (在...下方，不接触), under (在...下面，有遮盖)。 (Above/below/under: above (not touching), below (not touching), under (covered by).)
表示方向: to (到...), from (从...), across from (在...对面)。 (Direction: to, from, across from.)

example.question: The cat is hiding ______ (under / on) the bed.
steps: 1. 识别句子描述猫的藏匿位置。
2. 「under」表示在...下面，有遮盖；「on」表示在...上面。
3. 猫通常藏在床下，所以选择「under」。

mistakes.correct: He lives at school. (表示在学校学习生活，用at)

mistakes.wrong: The picture is on the wall.
mistakes.correct: The picture is on the wall. (表示附着于墙上，用on)

cards.memory_tip: 「地点介词不乱用，in on at分轻重；in大on小at更小，位置方向要分清！」(这是一个简化的口诀，实际in on at用法复杂)

exam_focus.scoring_key: 「理解介词词义，结合语境选择最恰当的介词」
exam_focus.common_trap: 「in, on, at的混淆；between与among的混淆（七下主要考between）」

real_exam_example.question: The bookstore is ______ the post office and the bank.
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 「考查介词between表示「在两者之间」的用法。」

cards.title: There be 句型：表达存在
cards.definition: There be句型表示「某地有某物」或「存在某事」，强调存在而非拥有。
core_points: 构成: There + be动词(is/are/was/were) + 名词 + 地点状语。 (Structure: There + be verb (is/are/was/were) + noun + place adverbial.)
主谓一致: be动词的形式由其后所跟的第一个名词的单复数决定。 (Subject-verb agreement: The form of the be verb is determined by the number of the first noun following it.)
否定句: 在be动词后加not，或用no代替a/an/some。 (Negative: Add not after the be verb, or use no instead of a/an/some.)
疑问句: 将be动词提前到There前。 (Interrogative: Move the be verb before There.)
过去式: There was / There were。 (Past tense: There was / There were.)

example.question: There ______ (be) a lot of trees in our school.
steps: 1. 识别句子是There be句型，表示存在。
2. 句中没有明确的过去时间状语，判断为一般现在时。
3. 「a lot of trees」是复数名词，所以be动词用are。

mistakes.wrong: There is two books on the desk.
mistakes.correct: There are two books on the desk. (two books是复数)

mistakes.wrong: Is there some water in the bottle?
mistakes.correct: Is there any water in the bottle? (疑问句中some变any)

exam_focus.scoring_key: 「掌握主谓一致的『就近原则』，区分some/any在肯定/否定/疑问句中的使用」
exam_focus.common_trap: 「be动词形式与后接名词单复数不一致；否定疑问句中some/any的误用」

real_exam_example.question: ______ (be) a new library in our town last year.
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 「根据时间状语「last year」判断为过去时，后接名词「a new library」为单数，故用was。」

cards.title: There be 句型：与have/has的区别
cards.definition: There be表示「某地有某物」，强调存在；have/has表示「某人拥有某物」，强调所属。
core_points: There be: 强调客观存在，主语是be动词后的名词。 (There be: Emphasizes objective existence, the subject is the noun after the be verb.)
have/has: 强调主观拥有，主语是拥有者。 (Have/has: Emphasizes subjective possession, the subject is the possessor.)
例句对比: There is a book on the desk. (桌上有一本书。) vs. I have a book. (我有一本书。) (Example comparison: There is a book on the desk. vs. I have a book.)
句型转换: There be句型通常不能直接转换为have/has句型，除非语境允许。 (Sentence transformation: There be cannot usually be directly transformed into have/has, unless context allows.)
时态一致: 两种句型都需注意时态与主谓一致。 (Tense consistency: Both sentence patterns require attention to tense and subject-verb agreement.)

example.question: Choose the best one: My classroom ______ (has / there is) 30 students.
steps: 1. 句意是「我的教室里有30名学生」。
2. 强调的是教室里『包含』学生，而不是教室『拥有』学生。
3. 「My classroom has」表达的是教室作为主体『拥有』某种属性或构成，更符合语境。
example.scoring_notes: 「此题容易误选there is。但教室作为容纳空间，常用has表示其内部构成。」

mistakes.wrong: There has a pen in my bag.
mistakes.correct: There is a pen in my bag. (There be句型)

mistakes.wrong: My school there are many trees.
mistakes.correct: My school has many trees. 或 There are many trees in my school. (混淆句型)

exam_focus.scoring_key: 「理解句意，区分『存在』与『拥有』的侧重点」
exam_focus.common_trap: 「见到『有』字就用There be，不考虑主语和语境」

real_exam_example.question: Our school ______ (have / there are) a big playground.
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 「学校作为主体，拥有操场，故用have/has。」

cards.title: 一般现在时 vs. 现在进行时
cards.definition: 一般现在时表示习惯性动作、事实或真理；现在进行时表示说话时或现阶段正在进行的动作。
core_points: 一般现在时: 经常性、习惯性动作（often, usually, every day），客观事实、真理。 (Simple Present: habitual actions, facts, truths.)
现在进行时: 说话时正在发生（now, look, listen），现阶段持续进行（this week, these days）。 (Present Continuous: happening at the moment of speaking, ongoing in the current period.)
时间状语: 是区分两种时态的关键线索。 (Time adverbs: Key clues to distinguish between the two tenses.)
状态动词: 不用于进行时（如like, love, know, want, have (拥有)）。 (Stative verbs: Not used in continuous tenses (e.g., like, love, know, want, have (possess)).)
瞬间动词: 一般不用进行时，但可表示重复或持续（如come, go）。 (Instantaneous verbs: Generally not used in continuous tenses, but can indicate repetition or continuation (e.g., come, go).)

example.question: My father usually ______ (read) newspapers in the morning, but now he ______ (watch) TV.
steps: 1. 识别第一个空的时间状语「usually」，表示习惯性动作，用一般现在时。
2. 识别第二个空的时间状语「now」，表示正在进行的动作，用现在进行时。
3. 根据主语和时态规则填空。

mistakes.correct: He likes apples. (like是状态动词，不用进行时)
They often play basketball. (often修饰一般现在时)

cards.memory_tip: 「一般现在表习惯，进行正发生；时间状语是信号，动词类别要分清！」

related.prerequisite: 一般现在时构成与用法，现在进行时构成与用法
related.next: 时态综合辨析，动词语态

exam_focus.scoring_key: 「准确识别时间状语和动词类型，理解句意是关键」
exam_focus.common_trap: 「状态动词误用进行时；时间状语与时态不匹配」

real_exam_example.question: Look! The baby ______ (sleep) soundly in the bed. He always ______ (sleep) for eight hours a day.
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 「第一空由Look!判断为现在进行时；第二空由always判断为一般现在时，且主语为He用三单形式。」

cards.title: 时间状语与时态选择：中考高频考点
cards.definition: 正确识别句中的时间状语是选择正确时态的关键，七年级下册主要涉及现在时和过去时的时间状语。
core_points: 一般现在时: every day/week/year, often, usually, always, sometimes, seldom, never等。 (Simple Present: every day/week/year, often, usually, always, sometimes, seldom, never, etc.)
现在进行时: now, right now, at the moment, look, listen, these days, this week/month等。 (Present Continuous: now, right now, at the moment, look, listen, these days, this week/month, etc.)
一般过去时: yesterday, last night/week/month/year, in 2008, just now, ago, once upon a time等。 (Simple Past: yesterday, last night/week/month/year, in 2008, just now, ago, once upon a time, etc.)
情态动词: 无固定时间状语，根据语境判断其语义。 (Modal verbs: No fixed time adverbs, judge meaning based on context.)
上下文语境: 即使没有明确时间状语，也要根据上下文判断时态。 (Context: Even without explicit time adverbs, judge tense based on context.)

example.question: My grandpa ______ (go) to bed at nine o'clock every night, but yesterday he ______ (go) to bed at ten.
steps: 1. 第一个空有时间状语「every night」，表示习惯性动作，用一般现在时。
2. 第二个空有时间状语「yesterday」，表示过去发生的动作，用一般过去时。
3. 动词「go」在一般现在时中需变三单，在一般过去时中用went。

mistakes.correct: He swam yesterday. (yesterday是过去时标志)
I am watching TV now. (now是进行时标志)

cards.memory_tip: 「时间状语是路标，时态选择看对照！」

related.prerequisite: 所有时态的构成，常见时间状语

exam_focus.scoring_key: 「熟记各时态典型时间状语，灵活运用排除法」
exam_focus.common_trap: 「混淆过去时间点与持续时间，如for five years与last year」

real_exam_example.question: Last Sunday, we ______ (have) a wonderful picnic. Now, we ______ (plan) another one.
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 「第一空Last Sunday为过去时间，用一般过去时had；第二空Now为现在进行时标志，用are planning。」

cards.title: 七下高频词汇：动词短语与固定搭配
cards.definition: 掌握七年级下册教材中常见的动词短语和介词固定搭配，是提升中考词汇与语法应用能力的关键。
core_points: look at (看), look for (寻找), look like (看起来像)。 (look at, look for, look like.)
take photos (拍照), take a walk (散步), take off (脱下/起飞)。 (take photos, take a walk, take off.)
get to (到达), get up (起床), get on/off (上/下车)。 (get to, get up, get on/off.)
talk to/with (和...说话), talk about (谈论)。 (talk to/with, talk about.)
be good at (擅长), be interested in (对...感兴趣), be afraid of (害怕)。 (be good at, be interested in, be afraid of.)
go to (去...), go for (去从事...), go shopping (去购物)。 (go to, go for, go shopping.)

example.question: My mother often ______ (go) shopping on weekends.
steps: 1. 识别固定搭配「go shopping」，表示「去购物」。
2. 识别时间状语「often on weekends」，表示习惯性动作，用一般现在时。
3. 主语「My mother」是第三人称单数，动词go需要变三单形式。

mistakes.correct: He is good at math. (固定搭配be good at)
Let's talk with him. 或 Let's talk about it with him. (talk about后直接跟内容，talk with后跟人)

cards.memory_tip: 「动词介词不分离，固定搭配要牢记！」

exam_focus.scoring_key: 「熟记高频动词短语和介词搭配，理解其准确含义」
exam_focus.common_trap: 「介词误用，或动词搭配错误；词义相近短语的混淆」

real_exam_example.question: Don't forget to ______ (look / look for) your lost dog.
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 「look for表示「寻找」，符合语境「寻找丢失的狗」。」
